source_basis.method: Ross 2011 precomputed steady-state face-flux continuity formulation
source_basis.discrete_balance: finite-volume continuity balance with first-order two-endpoint face-flux expansion at a selected sigma fraction of the trial step
source_basis.linear_system: one tridiagonal solve for Delta theta
source_basis.mass_statement: the same single-valued realized internal face flux must enter adjacent control-volume ledgers with opposite signs

qualified_hydraulics_reused_unchanged.family: Staringreeks 2018 unimodal MvG KSATFIT C1R base

state_and_derivative_contract.persistent_trial_input: theta_i represented physically by the equivalent unsaturated MvG head h_i
state_and_derivative_contract.face_derivative_chain_rule: dq/dtheta = dq/dh * dh/dtheta using the same MvG constitutive inverse; no finite-difference derivative in the candidate path
state_and_derivative_contract.trial_increment: Delta theta from one direct tridiagonal solve
state_and_derivative_contract.candidate_head: MvG inverse h(theta_candidate), used only as trial-result physical state; no second hydraulic trajectory is solved

discrete_equation.cell: Delta theta_i = dt/dz_i * (q_in_i^sigma - q_out_i^sigma + source_i - sink_i)
discrete_equation.internal_face: q_j^sigma = q_j^0 + sigma * (dq_j/dtheta_upper * Delta theta_upper + dq_j/dtheta_lower * Delta theta_lower)
discrete_equation.boundary_fluxes: top and bottom are prescribed external Darcy fluxes for Gate D and appear exactly once in the ledger
discrete_equation.sign: vertical Darcy flux positive downward; distributed source positive into storage and sink positive out of storage

precommitted_cases.profile_construction: deterministic logarithmic interpolation of head magnitude with a fixed sub-cell offset to avoid exact N241 node lines
precommitted_cases.boundary_flux_construction: deterministic fractions of K at the start-state boundary cells, frozen in the implementation before execution
precommitted_cases.source_sink_construction: deterministic bounded fractions of the same start-state hydraulic scale, frozen in the implementation before execution

hard_gates.internal_face_ledger_identity: bitwise same realized q_j^sigma object/value is used as outflow of cell j and inflow of cell j+1

mass_ledger.global_identity: sum_i dz_i*Delta theta_i = dt*(q_top - q_bottom + sum_i(source_i - sink_i))
mass_ledger.cell_identity: dz_i*Delta theta_i = dt*(q_{i-1/2}^sigma - q_{i+1/2}^sigma + source_i - sink_i)
mass_ledger.internal_flux_cancellation: each internal q^sigma occurs once positive and once negative in the global sum

explicit_nonclaims: Gate D does not qualify timestep accuracy or optimal sigma; that is Gate F.
Gate D does not qualify saturation or saturated-unsaturated transitions; that is Gate E.
Gate D does not qualify heterogeneous faces; that is Gate G.
Gate D uses prescribed-flux boundaries only and does not admit production bottom-boundary modes; that is Gate H.
Gate D does not qualify groundwater, MODFLOW coupling, runtime, MultiSWAP or FullRichards equivalence.
Gate D does not extend to Class-B H_ENPR or KSATEXM.
failure_policy: Any failed mass identity, invalid constitutive state, nonfinite value, unexpected branch transition or extra solve keeps D unqualified. Do not retune C1R tables, J1 derivatives, hydraulic physics, acceptance tolerances or timestep values after seeing results; a new revision requires a new precommit with the failure preserved.
